title: The Harvest Plate
story_setup: Long ago, the Pilgrims and the Wampanoag shared a harvest feast. Help Denny spiral through the big feast plate to the yummy center.
instruction: Long ago, the Pilgrims and the Wampanoag shared a harvest feast. Help Denny spiral through the big feast plate to the yummy center.
tts_instruction: Long ago, the Pilgrims and the Wampanoag shared a harvest feast. Help Denny spiral through the big feast plate to the yummy center.
educational_question: How long did that harvest feast last?
fun_fact: Three days! The Wampanoag brought deer, and the meal also included corn and wild birds.
completion_message: Denny reached the middle. Time to share a meal!
